notes: Bazel 9.2 was rejected after the pinned OR-Tools 9.15 transitive rules_go/rules_cc graph failed to build.
All local builder, Docker, Go, Cargo, Bazel and scanner state remained on /tmp-backed storage.

candidate.elf: ELF 64-bit LSB executable, x86-64, statically linked, stripped
candidate.rootfs: pinned distroless static runtime plus one candidate-owned layer

security.coverageLimitation: Syft and Grype may not infer every component linked into a stripped static ELF; compiler-owned closure and immutable license evidence remain independently required.
security.retention: The detailed local reports are content-addressed by these digests; the native amd64/arm64 workflow uploads the same bounded evidence and cross-architecture receipt without publishing an image.

failedPrecursor.reason: rules_cc appended an explicit dynamic -lstdc++ after target -static-libstdc++; the candidate exceeded 64 MiB and retained libstdc++.so.6 and libgcc_s.so.1, so the admission gate rejected it
failedPrecursor.correctiveAction: activate the toolchain fully_static_link feature, section GC, and an explicit final strip-all step; do not weaken the closure or size gates
